nav.label: Pricing and policies sections
nav.title: Pricing and policies
nav.description: Packio's sell margins, payment schedules and the guarantee policy — every change is a new version from its date
nav.nothing: You may not read any part of this desk yet

margins.title: Sell margins
margins.description: The tables that turn a factory's buy price into Packio's sell price, per product type, print type and kind
margins.listBody: A draft prices nothing until Superadmin or C-Level approves it.

createTable.title: New sell-margin table
createTable.body: One table per product type, print type (or every print type) and kind; draft its first version with lines next.
createTable.needDescription: Name the table (3 characters or more)
createTable.done: Table created — draft its first version
createTable.printTypeHint: Leave as every print type when the table applies to all of this product's printing

margin.draftWaiting: A draft is already waiting for approval
margin.draftBody: Prices use it from {date} once approved; approved after that date, it applies from the moment of approval.
margin.noneInForce: This table has no version in force; prices use the system defaults until one is approved.
margin.noFallback: No fallback when no line matches
margin.approveBody: {table}: {lines} lines, effective from {date} (or from now if that has passed). Its lines cannot change once approved.

lines.caption: Sell-margin lines
lines.hint: An empty bound is open. Runs include both ends; buy prices include the start and exclude the end.

errors.qtyOrder: the run's end is below its start
errors.priceOrder: the buy price's end must be above its start
errors.overlap: overlaps another line of the same colours and level

draft.title: Draft a new version
draft.bodyFrom: Starts from the lines of version {no}; the whole set is sent. The version in force stays until this one is approved.
draft.body: Enter every line of the table.
draft.badFallback: The fallback is a number (a percentage below 100)
draft.backDated: The effective date cannot be in the past
draft.needReason: Give a reason (3 characters or more)
draft.done: Draft saved — it waits for approval
draft.fallbackHint: Used when no line matches the job
draft.effectiveHint: Today means as soon as it is approved
draft.reasonHint: The approver and the audit log see this

schedules.title: Payment schedules
schedules.description: Templates that split an order group into instalments, chosen at checkout by priority and rule
schedules.body: Groups already placed keep their schedule; a new version applies to groups placed from its date.

scheduleVersion.title: New version of {name}
scheduleVersion.body: Instalments add up to 100 %; each says when it falls due and what it gates. The version applies from its date without an approval.

errors.label: Name every instalment in Thai and English.
errors.pct: An instalment's share is a number.
errors.total: The shares must add up to 100.
errors.bound: An order-value bound is an amount or setting:name.
errors.priority: The priority is a whole number.
errors.backDated: The effective date cannot be in the past.
errors.reason: Give a reason (3 characters or more).

scheduleVersion.ruleHint: Every condition given must hold; when several templates match, the lower priority wins.
scheduleVersion.effectiveHint: Today means a minute from now
scheduleVersion.restrictedHint: CS needs the permission to override schedules to choose this template instead of the one the system picks

guarantee.title: Guarantee policy
guarantee.description: How fast claims are answered and decided, and the remedies by claim type and severity
guarantee.body: The CS Lead proposes a version; C-Level approves it. An approved version applies from its date, never backwards; one proposal at a time.
guarantee.matrix: Remedies by claim type and severity
guarantee.withdrawBody: Its approval request is withdrawn with it; the policy in force does not change.
guarantee.proposeBody: Starts from the version in force; a cell left empty means no remedy under the policy.

errors.response: The answer time is at least 1 day
errors.decision: The decision time is at least 1 day
errors.backDated: The effective date cannot be in the past
errors.reason: Give a reason (3 characters or more)

guarantee.effectiveHint: Approved after this date, it applies from the approval
guarantee.matrixHint: Any other compensation goes through a discount memo.
